claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Estradiol valerate is a prodrug of estradiol that acts as an estrogen receptor agonist; at 2.5 uM it is not expected to be broadly cytotoxic, and any antiproliferative effect would be weak and mediated by ER-dependent growth inhibition in hormone-sensitive lines.
